equations: Raw experimental T,m/m0 arrays remain unchanged in reference.query. Explicit accepted transform: stable ascending T, first at duplicate T, normalize original first mass, clip[0,1], cummin. Every changed/removed point and max adjustment is recorded. This is a curve-anchored engineering proxy; variable-rate and atmosphere transfer are not Arrhenius kinetic prediction.

L_ref(Ts)=m0*(1-interp(projected_mass_fraction,Ts)); dL=max(0,L_ref(Ts)-L)*(1-exp(-dt/tau)). Irreversible actual L, but target is NOT latched: cancelled hot sample can continue losing mass under residual heat; cooled sample with L_ref<L stops. Above measured T rejected/faulted; optional cold extension is flat initial response explicitly accepted.

Oxidation du=min((m0*capacity-u)*(1-exp(-k*xO2*dt)),nO2*M_O2). k=k_ref*exp[-Ea/R*(1/Ts-1/Tref)] with explicit engineering inputs and overflow-bounded exponent. nO2 decreases by du/M_O2; uptake remains finite. This optional model is not inferred or calibrated by the mass-loss source.

Gas1 finite N2 supplies sample N2 plus independent balance N2. Gas2 finite O2 supplies sample only. dn=q_ref*p_ref/(R*T_ref)*dt. Chamber initial N2 is accounted. Fill the finite O2-consumption deficit first; remaining inlet performs exact exponential CSTR replacement exp(-dn/n_capacity), explicitly exhausting each species. Consumed O2 lowers total chamber moles/pressure until finite feed replenishes it; no free N2.

Reference-volume chamber is isothermal at explicitly supplied mixing T; p=nRT/V is not furnace hot-gas pressure. Unknown evolved volatile mass is tracked separately without guessed molecular weight; pyrolysis gas composition, pressure and sensible gas transport are not solved.

Es=(Cpan+mCp)*(Ts-Tamb); Ef=Cf*(Tf-Tamb). Emitted dm exports dm*Cp*(Ts_old-Tamb); incoming O2 has zero reference sensible enthalpy at ambient, explicit reaction heat q=dm_loss*h_loss+dm_O2*h_ox. Update finite sample energy, then solve the two-node thermal coupling implicitly. No Cp-change heat is invented.

Cf*dTf/dt=Pheater-Gambient*(Tf-Tamb)-Gcool*(Tf-Tamb)-Gs*(Tf-Ts); dEs/dt=Gs*(Tf-Ts)+reaction_heat-emitted_sensible. Heater=clip(K*(Tprogram-Tf),0,Pmax). Ambient/forced-cooling exchanges are signed. Gcool draws heat to ambient and cannot drive a passive body below ambient; heat removed remains in ledger. Whole-instrument1200W is NOT a measured heater rating.

Independent mass signal first-order approaches gain*(pan_mass+sample_mass)+offset; external calibration and empty-pan observed tare precede quantization8ng/60ng. Overload is unavailable, not a clipped sample truth. Furnace/sample temperatures are gain/offset observation proxies; no invented empirical noise or accuracy certification.

analysis.mass_stages consumes external observed time/T/mass/blank and independently supplied initial weighed mass. Explicit index windows yield signed mass changes, residual fraction and finite-difference DTG peak midpoint temperatures. This does not identify chemistry, source true residue or kinetic activation energy.

Pan domain: ceramic1473.15K, platinum1273.15K, aluminum873.15K, each ambient lower bound. The full furnace1200°C envelope is not valid for every pan. Linear ramp.01..500K/min; no unsupported ballistic algorithm.

Four engineering mechanisms: cold IR furnace vertical opening.11m;25-position shortest-path carousel;index1-only .016m punch demo;power. No pan reparenting/automatic transfer or physical lid rupture. Cold/load guards protect finite specimen and balance.

limitations: Ballistic heating inequality: Preserve both; no calibrated single ballistic bound inferred. Nominal controlled ramp .01..500 C/min is separate.
Purge flow configuration: Configuration/version dependence disclosed; implementation must explicitly choose IR rather than mixing settings.
Webpage unrelated DSC section: Do not assign DSC Tzero heat-flow sensors to TGA.
Pan limits: Pan-dependent limits, not one universal1200C pan capability.
FSRI gas metadata: Keep original metadata; nominal nitrogen method retained, exact split/flow conversion temperature-pressure unknown. Do not infer oxygen2.5/500 composition.
Signed mass change and negative residual: Keep source delta and negative baseline-corrected remainder. Engineering projection explicit, never source repair.
FSRI material names: Do not silently correct source labels; both same polystyrene identity group, morphology not new substance.
Native SI caption: Import original Table7 thresholds; no guessed graph-to-channel extraction.
Missing FSRI identity metadata: Preserve actual curves as reference-only; exclude these unknown identities from chemical target.
Zenodo 23013247 file-label spelling: Canonical names Hesperetin / trans-p-Coumaric acid with PubChem CAS/InChIKey; original labels retained in raw.file_label.
Catechin hydrate identity lookup: Resolve (+)-catechin hydrate CID 107957 / CAS 225937-10-0; enantiomer and water content not stated by dataset, flagged in identity_note.

FSRI data licence: Keep the 59 FSRI curves (already in the library) runtime-usable with an explicit unknown-licence flag per record; the >=50 runtime material target is met by the CC BY 4.0 Zenodo set alone.
Volatile compounds in Zenodo set: Runtime uses the measured curve as-is; limitations state that the loss is not decomposition-only.
Ammonium salt 1b identity heading typo: Use choline/2-hydroxyethyl cation identity, preserve erroneous raw heading, count1b once. No source Td value changed.
Author-reported Td is not Td5 or onset: Import as author_reported_decomposition_temperature_k with criterion null, reference_only. Estimated Tm footnotes not imported as measurements.
159条跨仪器实测曲线（Zenodo 23013247 的50种化合物N2与O2/N2各一条、FSRI 59条N2）均可锚定运行目标；速率/气氛/坩埚/初重转移和热滞后不可从单条曲线辨识，须显式工程接受。
原质量分数不裁剪；运行clip[0,1]/cummin等若启用必须报告变更点，不能当真实原样品动力学。
自由悬挂100uL陶瓷盘内R3.9mm深2.1mm、炉下移110mm、托盘±π、冲头16mm index1均工程局部尺寸/动作；34kg分件质量未知。
冲孔预留孔为操作代理，不模拟断膜；托盘完整摆入称量位/盘移交重新挂载/自动队列未实现；外部热交换器和软管变形未建。
整机1200W不是实测加热器功率；未知反应热、氧化速率、传热系数、温场和漂移噪声不能冒原厂实测。
FSRI样品在NETZSCH PtRh坩埚测量、Zenodo样品在NETZSCH TG209F1氧化铝坩埚测量，映射到TGA5500盘是显式跨仪器/坩埚工程转移；原曲线不保证相同测试响应。
带25位圆形自动进样器和IR炉的TGA5500整机560×560×610mm、34kg取自厂家/任务书；外部热交换器不在外廓与质量内，局部尺寸、部件质量及机械行程未知且只作显式工程装配。
样品由自由悬挂细线/吊篮承载，不是DSC的固定双pan平台；IR炉竖直下降110mm用于冷态装样展示，工程行程不是厂家实测。
25位圆盘可索引旋转，盘位排布和支架依据5500照片定性还原；完整自动移交、托盘摆入称量位、抓取重新挂载和自动队列未实现，不以圆盘索引宣称完成自动进样。
封盘冲头为16mm直线工程代理，只允许转盘停止在1号演示位时下降；演示盘预留真孔，不模拟材料断裂、气密膜破坏或实际密封性能。
主样品盘采用100µL陶瓷几何配置，能够示意1200°C温区；封盘冲头配套盘为另一独立展示耗材，不把铝盘600°C上限当成陶瓷/本机温区。
透明部分仅为照片可见的局部转盘防护围圈；IR炉、主机罩和天平罩均不透明，剖视图仅为模型观察时隐藏零件。
触屏仅温度C与质量mg两个FONT/状态读数区域代理；不复现TRIOS菜单、动态图标及真实触屏交互。
固定管路、内部IR灯/石英衬/天平支撑局部细节为功能支持的工程示意，实际电热设计、气密密封、运动软管变形和热交换器未知。
部件真实质量均null；仅将厂家整机34kg用于URDF数值预算分配，惯量为包围盒近似。真实网格接合/连续扫掠证明不等同接触求解或硬件校准。
冷态装样与移除改变有限样品库存；悬挂样品盘与圆形进样盘是静态装配代理，未验证自动夹取、落盘接触和盖膜破裂。
运行默认热容、热导、加热功率、样品Cp、失重松弛及可选氧化参数均为显式工程输入；具体SI数值保存于implementation_assumptions。
有限腔体参考温度与高温炉气温度分离；不猜测未知分解气体分子量、压力或浮力。
Matterix逐步写入过程权威关节位置并清零速度，再更新驱动目标；实际q/FK一致性不等于电机力矩、伺服动力学或接触验证。
No OEM HiRes/MTGA/MS/FTIR proprietary algorithm or calibrated sensor noise.
Reaction enthalpy, Cp, conductance, relaxation and optional O2 kinetics explicitly assumed.
Finite balance N2 stream is accounted but thermal entrainment/buoyancy of purge is not modeled.
Loss species mass reservoir has no asserted molecular composition, chamber pressure feedback or ideal-gas conversion.
After a model-domain fault reactions halt until sample removal/reload; no unsupported extrapolation or free restoration.
Joint/mesh and Matterix multi-env validation are separate; no autonomous physical pan pickup.
